evidence.observation: Native call/return checkpoints are preferred to tracing every syscall for an initial missing-device branch hypothesis. Successful open, cached descriptor, changed bool/state or unexpected access must stop; no device read/write is silently continued. Required controls include breakpoint rotation, normal atomic completion, register preservation, deadlines and group cleanup. Main-thread transport visibility limits are explicit. No guest run or native observer modification occurred. Commit and push before observer implementation.
